name: MagicMouse
author: 2strange
description: Apple Magic Mouse that feels like on a Mac, about 98% of the real thing: touchpad-style scrolling with glide, live two-finger workspace swipe, Apple's pointer curve, edge and palm rejection, several mice at once, battery in the bar and in Bluetooth settings. Since 1.4 touch is finally clean: the mouse itself reports hover versus touch, a byte Linux's hid_magicmouse driver normally drops; install.sh turns on the driver's report_undeciphered option to pass it on. 2.0 is a rewrite in Rust: one small binary, no Python packages, about 1% CPU while scrolling on a Late 2013 MacBook Pro (1.x: about 5%) and about 9x less CPU time in the touch engine.
